==Acquisition==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
*[[Nightfall]]
**[[Yoannh the Rebuilder]] ([[The Ruptured Heart]]) (requires a party member to be carrying a [[Proof of Triumph]])

Note that as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]] skill, [[Elite Skill Tome|Elite Skill Tomes]] cannot be used to learn this skill.

==Related skills==
*{{skill icon|Lyssa's Aura}} ([[elite]])

==Notes==
{{see|Guide to playing as a dervish#Builds and team roles}}
*The skill reapplies itself before new enchantments are applied, so those will [[cover]] Vow of Revolution.
*This skill enables the dervish to play a support role in PvE using its secondary profession (i.e. [[Orders build]]); either defensively with [[Ritualist]]'s [[Restoration Magic]] skills or [[Monk]]'s [[Protection Prayers]] skills, or offensively with [[Necromancer]]'s [[Blood Magic]] skills.

==Trivia==
*This skill uses an altered version of the icon for the ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' [[gw2:Spellbreaker|Spellbreaker]] skill [[gw2:Featherfoot Grace|Featherfoot Grace]].
*Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|22nd April 2020 update]] as part of the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].
